title: Characterization of temporary addresses
statement: For natural numbers $k,F$ and an integer $a$, let $c_T(j)=-(23+4j)$ and let the temporary address set consist of $-13$ together with the values $c_T(j)$ for $k\le j\le 2F$. Then $a$ belongs to this set if and only if either $a=-13$, or $c_T(2F)\le a\le c_T(k)$ and $4$ divides $c_T(0)-a$.
